facts.event: Elise 随兄长 Isen 离开新塔、走向内堡，宫苑因夏季节庆而人马来往繁忙。
facts.relation: 兄妹：Elise 与 Isen（黑王子）
facts.anchor: following Isen out of the new towers and toward the keep

facts.event: 国王 Liran 在跑马绿地检视商人献上的鹰，旁人一提婚礼，Elise 便心惊，Isen 却避开她的目光。
facts.relation: 父女：Elise 与国王 Liran；兄妹：Elise 与 Isen
facts.anchor: considering a hawk that had been placed on his arm by an eager-looking merchant

facts.event: High Priest Dagobert 以服丧未满一年为由反对国王再娶，Liran 冷回决定已定、婚约已签、新娘已在路上。
facts.relation: 君臣/政教：Liran 与 High Priest Dagobert
facts.numbers: It has not been a year; She is already on her way
facts.anchor: It has not been a year

facts.event: Elise 终于明白父亲要再娶，且这回娶的是 Merogia 的异教徒。
facts.anchor: her father intended to marry again

facts.event: Isen 拒绝 Synod 的圣战征召，并讥讽弟弟 Conrin 从未打过一场不是为他摆好的仗。
facts.relation: 兄弟：Isen 与 Conrin；王权与教会：Isen 与 Synod
facts.anchor: he has yet to fight in any battle that has not been staged for his entertainment

facts.event: Liran 命 Elise 充任 Ardweni 新后的陪伴与宫廷向导，她压下出家之愿，仍答“Yes Father”。
facts.relation: 父女：Liran 与 Elise；未来的君臣：Elise 与 Ardweni 新后
facts.numbers: eight years since he had deigned to give her more than a breath of his time
facts.anchor: Elise will ensure the Ardweni woman knows the ways of the court

facts.event: Isen 安抚她这差事只到新后怀孕安顿为止，并道出实情：Synod 出资东征，Merogia 若不平定国库将被拖垮。
facts.relation: 兄妹：Isen 与 Elise；王权与教会：Synod 与王室
facts.numbers: a few months; five of the Merogian kingdoms
facts.anchor: It will only be for a few months

facts.event: 入夜后 Elise 在房中不加纺织，反把骨梭尖按进掌心新伤，末尾梦见自己能听见树木说话。
facts.relation: 自我/信仰：Elise 与 Wing 的信条
facts.anchor: she dreamed she could hear the trees speak
